item.title: Hotfix 14.2
item.description:
HOTFIX 14.1

GENERAL FIXES

- Fixed an issue where Accolades were not granted after a Weekly Siege or Weekly Eternal War, despite being counted in the Lectern of Oaths.

item.title: Nagash & Glottkin Campaign Overview
